doc.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Upcoming TV work and goodbyes
summary: Burt Reynolds movie, Hollywood life, and closing thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has really been just a treat. When is the next unexpected time I might hear you on television do you suppose?
I’ll be on the 28th, on the Burt Reynolds movie. It’s called “Hard Time,” on Ted Turner’s network, TNT.
Oh you’re in it? And you play on it?
Hey man you’ve got it going from both ends.

Yeah. anything for a buck, man. But you know Burt Reynolds is great, he loves jazz too, and he’s a great guy. And Charles Durning is in it, he’s a great actor. And it’s so fun, I’ll tell you, I love these people. It’s great to be around them. You go and you get a big trailer and you go and you just sit in there and wait and I practice and wait, and go do the scene and everybody treats you so good, it’s great. Hollywood is a great life, it really is.
Good. Well thank you for coming.
And I most appreciated getting your stories and you’ve added some things I haven’t heard before for sure.
